headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 3, 2026**
article:
The Miami Marlins secured a 4-1 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Max Meyer earning the win after pitching 7.0 innings with 7 strikeouts and 1 earned run. Esteury Ruiz led the Marlins' offense with a home run and 1 RBI. The Detroit Tigers also secured a win, taking down the Tampa Bay Rays 7-2. Dillon Dingler led the Tigers' offense, while Troy Melton dominated on the mound.

Several players have been impacted by injuries, with Joe Mantiply being transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to left knee inflammation for the Toronto Blue Jays. The Braves have also bolstered their roster with the acquisition of catcher Austin Wynns from the Los Angeles Angels in exchange for cash.

The Braves made a trade to acquire catcher Austin Wynns from the Los Angeles Angels in exchange for cash. The Toronto Blue Jays also made a trade, acquiring right-handed pitcher Simeon Woods Richardson from the Minnesota Twins for cash.

top_news.title: **Marlins Take Down Nationals 4-1**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured a 4-1 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Max Meyer earning the win after pitching 7.0 innings with 7 strikeouts and 1 earned run. Esteury Ruiz led the Marlins' offense with a home run and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Rays 7-2**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a 7-2 victory over the Tampa Bay Rays, with Dillon Dingler leading the offense and Troy Melton dominating on the mound.

top_news.title: **White Sox Shut Out Twins 8-0**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox dominated the Minnesota Twins, securing an 8-0 victory. Andrew Benintendi led the offense with a home run and 2 RBIs, while Erick Fedde earned the win on the mound.

top_news.title: **Mets Take Down Mariners 7-1**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets secured a 7-1 victory over the Seattle Mariners, with Freddy Peralta earning the win after pitching 6.0 innings with 6 strikeouts and 1 earned run. J.P. Crawford led the Mariners' offense with 3 hits, including a home run.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays' Joe Mantiply Shifted to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Toronto Blue Jays left-handed pitcher Joe Mantiply has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to left knee inflammation.

top_news.title: **Braves Acquire Catcher Austin Wynns**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves have made a trade to bolster their roster, acquiring catcher Austin Wynns from the Los Angeles Angels in exchange for cash. Wynns joins the Braves after the trade was finalized.
